scope: Sixteen generic identities connecting the existing Std CellCode to the existing equal-angle Cell, bitmasks, integer supplier indices and actual circle phases.

semantic_checks.finding: Copies level and all five natural indices exactly; no rounding, chart substitution, permutation or validity assumption.
Both denominators are 19*2^level. Valid is exactly level<=7 and five index bounds; the actual decidable Bool validCheck is equal, not merely implication under assumed validity.
Both masks are Fin32 with Nat.testBit at coordinate index. Each child copies level+1 and coordinate 2*index+bit. This preserves the exact five binary choices needed by C18 ordered child lists.

Natural-division definitions, factor2 midpoint index, lower/upper indices and mask endpoint choices are definitionally identical. No replacement of truncating integer expressions by real expressions occurs.

normalizedIndex uses signed Euclidean remainder modulo218880 then toNat; shiftedIndex subtracts (i+1)*k*36480 in Int before normalization. It does not use truncating tdiv here. The unconditional shifted-index upper bound is inherited from the existing checked supplier theorem.

midpoint_circle and endpoint_circle bind actual circlePoint values at the integer Fourier indices to fourierTarget on the corresponding continuous cell midpoint or mask endpoint. Their explicit level<=7 hypothesis is retained; no claim is made for arbitrary deeper cells.

The two phase identities need no index validity because they are periodic identities for natural indices; this does not prove that such an arbitrary cell belongs to the root grid or is feasible. Validity and coverage remain separate.
The general cell bridge allows level<=7; the concrete sparse table and leaf checks retain their separate level<=4 gates. This source neither weakens those gates nor supplies table values.
